text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I still remember what happened that day so 
clearly.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
The school grounds in the early afternoon. 
The warm breeze, the scent of dirt. The 
murmurs, the applause, countless eyes 
watching.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Amazing! Amazing, amazing, she's so 
amazing! What was her name again? The one 
I just saw, I think it was—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"I was invited and casually entered that 
little kids' race. That was the day my 
once-hazy outline finally came into sharp 
focus for the world to see."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: I remembered, "Dants Flame"!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: If I become the "lead."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"That I could become special. That day I 
realized it—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today marks the memorable day when the 
challenge for the Twinkle Series begins.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Once again, I look forward to working with 
you from today o—

text_block_list.name: Tachyon & Pocket
text_block_list.text: Haaah!! Daaaaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Huh...!? Tachyon-chan and Pokke-chan!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The two were locked in a fierce, heated 
duel— A huge crowd packed the stands, 
pointing at the track and buzzing with 
excitement.

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
"Man, I can't believe she hasn't even 
debuted yet! What tremendous 
potential...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Running on the track were Agnes Tachyon, 
an Umamusume who hole up in her lab daily 
to pursue the latent potential of 
Umamusume, and—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Former freestyle racing team leader, 
Jungle Pocket. It seems the two of them 
are running side by side.

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
That speed, that acceleration...! Above 
all else, it's just so brilliant!!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Ohooo! I can't wait to see how they do in 
the Classic races!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ............ They really are both amazing.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, no, no! I'm me, after all, right! 
Gotta switch gears, switch gears!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I look forward to working with 
you again!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Feeling the excitement of the tandem run 
behind me, the first training session 
began. She completed the scheduled menu 
without a hitch—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...! Haah, haah! Focus on the core, focus 
on the core...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...*phew*. Alright, that's everything for 
today, right!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. I look forward to 
working with you again tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Ended without a single issue.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
“—Whoops, excuse me! Would it be alright 
if I do some self-training after this?”

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Here is the menu I'd like to do today. 
Please look it over!

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
—Huh, doing voluntary training starting on 
the very first day, huh? She really is 
such a dedicated girl.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
Hey. You must have some dream you want to 
make come true, right?
choice_data_list:
Yeah. A dream of becoming the "main 
character."

Yeah. It's the dream of becoming the "main 
character."

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
I see! In that case, she can definitely 
get at least one win. I know she can do 
it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just a single win in the Twinkle Series is 
more than enough to earn you the title of 
a "top contender" on that stage.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It may also be said that she was the star 
of that race."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Would you please aim to become the "lead 
role" together with me?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The smile directed at me that day—what 
dwelled within it was an unmistakable 
flame."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What Dantsu Flame aims to be is a dazzling 
"protagonist" who leaves a lasting 
impression on everyone's heart.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The kind who always wins in GⅠ races, 
going toe-to-toe with the very top 
Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No, perhaps even that is merely a stepping 
stone for the "star of the era."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
By the time I finished up my work and left 
the Trainer's Room, it was already late at 
night.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before heading back to the dorm, a thought 
strikes me, and I buy something before 
making my way to the grounds. Knowing her, 
she might still be out there training.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant*!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She doesn't possess speed reminiscent of 
light, nor does she have wild, explosive 
acceleration. And she surely understands 
that better than anyone.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Taah!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
*pant, gasp*!! ...Ngh!! Not yet, not yet, 
this isn't enough!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I won't reach at this rate! Then I'll just 
push from right hereeee!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, there's not the slightest sign of 
giving up.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, no good. I still can't hit speeds 
like Tachyon-chan, after all. I guess I 
still need to work on conditioning my body 
first...
choice_data_list: Good work! You're really working hard!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"O-Oh! Trainer? How long have you been 
there?"
choice_data_list:
A little while ago, I think. More 
importantly...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I took out the independent training menu 
she had given me and spread it open.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Something felt off while watching her 
train earlier. Yes, the load looked higher 
than what had been reported.
choice_data_list:
That kind of speed might be too much 
strain for my body right now.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Huh? —Whoa, I'm sorry!
choice_data_list:
Let's take on the challenge once you're in 
a bit better shape.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Yes! I'll be careful...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still, it shows her fighting spirit. And 
so—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I handed her the "Farm-Fresh Triple Milk 
Doughnut" that I had bought at the 
convenience store earlier.
choice_data_list:
Still, that's a wonderful attitude to 
have!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: T-Traiiineeeer!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Ehehe~ I'm so happy~

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. Oh right, while I'm 
at it, I should post this on Umastagram 
later—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: "...Um, could I ask you a favor later on?"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I'm thinking of starting an Umastagram 
account!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
A friend told me that apparently, a lot of 
people discover racing through Umastagram 
and end up cheering for us.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"...What matters most to be the star is, 
of course, raw racing ability."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
“Setting that aside, though, you know how 
plain I am! Even if I get good results, I 
might not stand out at all.”

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"So I thought I'd give people more reasons 
to notice Dantsu Flame, even if just a 
little."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I'm still thinking over the overall 
direction, but I plan to take it one 
steady step at a time♪

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"So... I want a photo with a nice vibe to 
use for that icon."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Could you take a picture for me if you'd 
like? Taking a selfie feels a bit 
embarrassing.
choice_data_list: If that's the case, of course!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Might as well find a spot with a nice 
view. And so, after eating the donuts—"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
How about around here? It's nice and open, 
so—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Look, Trainer. It's so pretty!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Where she pointed, a beautiful 
first-magnitude star sparkled brightly.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ah... The stars are nice, but look— the 
moon is just so pretty!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hurriedly, I looked up once more— How 
could I have missed it? A giant orange 
full moon was shining brilliantly.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
... The surrounding stars look so faint, 
don't they?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I hope that someday I can be like that 
too... or something.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"With sparkling eyes, she looked up at the 
full moon. As if enveloping her, faint 
moonlight quietly rained down—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Splash)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Wah!?
choice_data_list:
Sorry, it was just such a good shot, I 
couldn't resist.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dants Flame—an Umamusume whose pursuit of 
her dreams shines brighter than anyone's.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
――... Oh, wow! It doesn't even look like 
me, haha.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, alongside her, my days of chasing 
after the "spotlight" began.
